This lesion displays marked enhancement, significant necrosis, ependymal invasion and midline crossing, all arguing against 1p/19q codeletion. The frontal‑lobe and cortical location are compatible with codeletion but are outweighed by the high‑grade imaging pattern, so the prediction is non‑codeleted.
